The one that got away. Pre-dawn over an open black ocean: a bruised sky of deep navy and ash-rose, a calm dark sea with long low swells. In the middle-right of the frame, a colossal whale-bodied armored ark is diving: a long arcing hull made of many overlapping segments of dark armored plate, curving down into the black water like a whale sounding, the front half already gone under, its great mechanical tail fluke still raised above the surface mid-stroke. More than a third of the frame is the dark water swallowing the ark. Palette of ash-navy dawn, teal glow accents and foam greys. No text, no letters, no user interface.
